content.rendered:
Middleton’s Scholastic Book Fair November 1 – 5. The book fair is open to students and staff only, but this year we’ve added eWallet – a safe, cashless way for your child to shop at the Book Fair.

Students will be able to shop during their scheduled classroom library time. Check out the Middleton Book Fair Homepage for more information, as well as teacher eWallet links, if you would like to donate to your child’s classroom.
